episodes.198422: This storm arrived on the 21st, and provided light rain, high elevation snow, and strong gusty winds. This later system appeared to be the most impactful as southwest to west winds approached 35-45 mph across lower elevation Sierra communities and the Sierra Front morning through the afternoon time period on the 21st with wind gusts exceeding 90 mph along exposed Sierra ridgetops. This storm system brought additional impacts to recreation, and brought bumpy flights into and out of regional airports. Rain and snow totals were relatively meager with this storm with accumulated snowfall of only 1-4 inches confined to elevations above 7000-7500 feet on the night of the 22nd.
episodes.198553: Heavy rain led to river flooding on the Cache River at Patterson in Late December.

events.narrative: A CO-OP observer (TAAC1 Tahoma) located in Tahoma, CA, reported a 24 hour rainfall total of 0.62 inches.

The Cache River at Patterson flooded during late December with the river site continuing to flood into mid-January. The crest of the Cache River at Patterson would occur in moderate flood stage at 11.02 feet on December 31st at 2230.
